immersiveSection.subtitle: I build interactive 3D and VR experiences that run in the browser and on Meta Quest, made from real rooms, real data and real landscapes.

cases.title: Apartment renovation, planned in VR
cases.body: An empty concrete shell, scanned and turned into a walkable 3D model. Furniture, lighting, sockets and plumbing are placed at real scale. Notes spoken inside the headset are applied in Blender and show up back in VR a few minutes later.
points: Room scan to Blender to WebXR model
Voice notes from the headset, applied live

cases.title: 3D Learning Encyclopedia
cases.body: A growing encyclopedia of 3D worlds children can walk through: the solar system with moons and NASA spacecraft, a time machine back to the dinosaurs, and a shrink ray into a drop of pond water, the bloodstream and a living cell. Every stop has narration in Armenian.
points: Solar system, dinosaurs and the micro world
Narration and a kids' mode in Armenian
Runs in the browser and on Meta Quest

upworkSection.title: From a medical education platform to the United Nations
upworkSection.intro: For five years, companies have hired me through Upwork, mostly for websites, platforms and integrations. 64 completed projects later, the profile carries Upwork's Top Rated Plus badge, which goes to the top-performing freelancers on the platform. These five show the range:
upworkSection.background: MSc Engineering, TU Wien. Before DigiDog: system development at SMA Solar Technology and digital project management at Siemens. Identity verified on Upwork.

story.text: A full-stack streaming platform for medical education, built with Next.js, Strapi and MongoDB, with Vimeo video.
Website redesign for a German dental clinic chain. The conversion rate went from 5% to 11%.
Three years of web administration for the condition-monitoring brand of Fluke, part of the Fortive group.
After an acquisition, two brands merged into one website: 200+ pages redesigned and consolidated.
The FP2030 Progress Report website, with interactive Highcharts data visualisations.
